## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (required for user-facing changes)
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Risk and data handling

- [ ] No credentials, personal recordings, local state, or generated reports are included.
- [ ] Owner authorization and generated-audio disclosure remain intact.
- [ ] Schema or environment changes include migration, setup, and rollback notes.

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visual changes, or write “Not applicable.”
